QuestInfo.name: Orbis Winter Preparations
QuestInfo.0: Ericsson in Orbis thirsts for royal red tea, which is a delicacy of winter. Go see Ericsson.
QuestInfo.1: He may look rough, but Ericsson longs for a taste of elegance. He asks you to bring him 20 Red Tea Bags so that he can try some Nependeath Royal Red Tea, a winter delicacy. It probably won't taste very good, but you should let him find that out for himself.
QuestInfo.2: Ericsson of Orbis wanted to drink Nependeath Royal Red Tea, a winter delicacy, and asked you to bring him Red Tea Bags from monsters. He seemed to enjoy it, but you are still not convinced about its taste.

0.0: Red Tea is perfect for this cold weather. Especially Red Tea made of Nependeath leaves, which Nero also loves. Nependeath leaves picked in winter are the best since they're tender and not too bitter. Ah, now I just got to drink some. Why don't you try some, too?

yes.0: Nothing is free. Go to the strolling path at Cloud Park and bring back some #e#bRed Tea Bags#k#n. 20 bags will be enough to brew some good red tea. In the winter, even the other monsters enjoy drinking Nependeath Royal Red Tea, so you should be able to obtain them easily. \n\n#b#i4032564# #t4032564# x 20

no.0: You don't know what life is yet. Red tea on a cold winter day is the beauty of life.
